TIMING PROVEN - fixed statutory cadence, every Friday 15:30 ET with prior-Tuesday data. Next print 2026-08-28 15:30 ET (Tuesday 2026-08-25 data), then weekly through 2026-12-31. WHY: the run's entire positioning read is dated 2026-08-18, ten days stale, and predates the 2026-08-24 LME squeeze in full; this is the first observation containing that week. Basis carried on every figure: COMEX COPPER- #1, DISAGGREGATED, FUTURES-ONLY, in LOTS - not the futures-and-options combined basis. BULLISH TRIGGER: net length above +79,027 lots, the 156-week window maximum set 2026-08-11. BEARISH TRIGGER: net length falls 10,000 lots or more week-on-week (-12.7% of the current +78,648) or below the 156-week mean of +31,136 lots. COMPARABLE (section 17): the same week a year earlier on the identical basis, +25,609 lots on 2025-08-19, giving a twelve-month build of +53,039 lots. BACK-TEST on the last two reported periods: +79,027 (2026-08-11) and +78,648 (2026-08-18), a week-on-week change of -379 lots - neither trigger fired, so the status quo does NOT satisfy either side and the trigger is CAPABLE OF FAILING. Direction neutral by construction: this is a crowding gauge, not a price direction. Positioning levels are causally owned by commodity-positioning-flows and are referenced here, not re-voted.

THE ONE TO WATCH. TIMING PROVEN - every LME business day, 09:00 London; next print 2026-08-28. WHY: it is the only fully date-proven high-frequency reading of the constraint this run measured as binding. LME on-warrant stock 107.05 kt on 2026-08-27 = 1.4 days of world use, after a 35.8% one-week fall from 166.775 kt on 2026-08-20, with 50.52% of LME stock already cancelled (2026-08-21); ex-US cover 3.7 days; 69.8% of the 968.4 kt visible total sits in US warehouses. BULLISH TRIGGER: on-warrant closes below 78.7 kt on any daily report - one day of world use at the 78.7 kt/day rate implied by 968.4 kt = 12.3 days (968.4/12.3 = 78.73, my arithmetic) - together with LME cash-3M backwardation wider than US$550/t, the 2026-08-24 level. BEARISH TRIGGER: on-warrant recovers above 166.8 kt (strictly greater than its 2026-08-20 level of 166.775 kt) AND cash-3M flips to contango. BACK-TEST on the last two reported days: 166.775 kt (2026-08-20) and 107.05 kt (2026-08-27) - the bullish threshold was NOT met on either, and the bearish threshold was not exceeded on either (166.775 does not exceed 166.8; read as a strict inequality). CAPABLE OF FAILING. WHAT THE THRESHOLD IMPLIES FOR THE UNREPORTED PART: from 107.05 kt a further -26.5% draw is required to clear 78.7 kt; the preceding week's draw was -35.8%, so one more week at that pace clears it - reachable, not automatic, and not a rubber stamp. Direction neutral: the row is a scheduled observation, and the inventory level itself is causally owned by commodity-demand-inventory and is referenced, not re-voted.

TIMING PROVEN for the cadence - every Friday that is a Chinese working day, after the 15:00 CST close; next 2026-08-28; SUSPENDED over Golden Week 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07. NO NUMERIC TRIGGER IS EMITTED, DELIBERATELY, and that refusal is the finding. The two figures this run holds are SHFE warrant 56.7 kt (2026-08-19) and a weekly WAREHOUSE figure of 70.1 kt (week 32) - 24% apart because they are two different definitions, not a reconciliation - and no year-earlier figure on either basis was obtained. Under CLAUDE.md section 15 (matched basis) and section 17 a threshold I cannot measure the same way twice cannot be tested, so a number here would be false precision. Strength held to 0.1 to reflect that this row schedules an observation and asserts nothing. Data need recorded: a year-earlier SHFE warrant figure on the warrant basis.

TIMING PROVEN for the cadence - every CME business day. WHY: COMEX registered + eligible stock of 676.1 kt on 2026-08-25 is 69.8% of all visible copper, and it is precisely the metal whose accessibility the Section 232 refined question decides. BULLISH TRIGGER: registered + eligible falls below 500 kt (-26.0% from 676.1 kt), i.e. US-held metal starts leaving for the seaborne market. BEARISH TRIGGER: rises above 750 kt (+10.9%). THE THRESHOLD IS EXPLICITLY WEAK AND IS LABELLED SO: no year-earlier COMEX figure on the same registered+eligible basis was obtained this run, so both levels are anchored on the current print alone rather than on a like-for-like comparable, and the section 17 two-period back-test could only be run on ONE period (676.1 kt on 2026-08-25, which satisfies neither trigger). Not a rubber stamp on that one period, but not a completed test either. Data need recorded.

TIMING: RECURRENCE PROVEN, EXACT DATE NOT PUBLISHED - ICSG lists releases after the fact and publishes no forward calendar. Day-of-month has clustered around the 20th-22nd; latest listed release 2026-08-21; next expected ~2026-09-21, ~2026-10-21, ~2026-11-20, all PATTERN-DERIVED and labelled vague. WHY: it is the only OFFICIAL world refined balance, and this run could not establish the 2026 balance sign at all - the same reported ICSG release gives a +96 kt surplus headline and a -125 kt implied deficit from its own reported +0.4% production / +1.6% usage growth rates, a 221 kt contradiction pointing opposite ways. BULLISH TRIGGER: the next cumulative year-to-date world refined balance prints a DEFICIT (below zero). BEARISH TRIGGER: cumulative Jan-Jun 2026 prints above +600 kt surplus. COMPARABLE: the same cumulative period a year earlier on the ICSG preliminary world refined balance basis. BACK-TEST on the last two reported periods: Q1-2026 +396 kt and Q1-2025 +135 kt - neither trigger fired, so both are CAPABLE OF FAILING. WHAT THE THRESHOLDS IMPLY FOR THE UNREPORTED PART, with the arithmetic shown: for Jan-Jun 2026 to reach zero from +396 kt at Q1, Q2-2026 ALONE must have run a deficit of at least -396 kt; for Jan-Sep to reach zero, Q2+Q3 combined must total at least -396 kt. That is a DEMANDING bar, not a low one, and a deficit print must be read against it. The +600 kt bearish threshold requires Q2-2026 to add more than +204 kt on top of Q1's +396 kt (600 - 396 = 204, my arithmetic). GAP: the Jan-Jun 2025 cumulative comparable was NOT obtained this run and is not invented.

HIGHEST-IMPACT ITEM ON THE CALENDAR, and it loses the one-to-watch slot only on timing. TIMING: WINDOW PROVEN, EXACT DATE NOT PUBLISHED - window late September to end-October 2026, hence expiry 2026-10-31. Prior rounds: spring 2026-04-23 (Copper Market Forecast 2026-2027), autumn 2025-10-08 / Oct-2025, autumn 2024-09-26. WHY: it is the only release that can resolve or repeat the 221 kt contradiction that stopped this run from establishing a balance direction, and it sets the first revision to the 2027 number. BULLISH TRIGGER: the 2027 balance is cut from +377 kt to below zero - a swing of more than 377 kt on the same body, same forecast horizon, same basis. BEARISH TRIGGER: the 2027 surplus is raised above +377 kt, or the 2026 balance is revised further into surplus above +96 kt. COMPARABLE (section 17, same forecast horizon on the same basis): the spring-2026 round's own 2027 figure of +377 kt, NOT a realised balance. BACK-TEST on the last two rounds: autumn-2025 forecast 2026 at -150 kt DEFICIT, spring-2026 forecast 2026 at +96 kt SURPLUS and 2027 at +377 kt - BOTH SIDES HAVE FIRED across those two rounds, a 246 kt swing between consecutive rounds. This is the strongest genuinely two-way test on the calendar and is emphatically CAPABLE OF FAILING. Direction neutral: the release can land either way with comparable force and no probability is held for either.

TIMING: CADENCE PROVEN (NBS publishes an annual release calendar), EXACT 2026-09 DATE NOT READ THIS RUN - stats.gov.cn returned ECONNREFUSED, so 2026-09-15 is derived from the year-earlier equivalent release and is labelled pattern-derived. Then mid-October (September data plus Q3 GDP), mid-November, mid-December. WHY: the profile calls China property and grid spend a DOMINANT copper driver. BASIS TRAP CARRIED EXPLICITLY (CLAUDE.md section 27): NBS fixed-asset investment is a CUMULATIVE YEAR-TO-DATE year-on-year rate, NOT a standalone-month rate, so a standalone-month comparison is the wrong comparable and is refused. Latest readings: FAI -6.7% and property -19.2%, both cumulative YTD y/y, both worsening. BULLISH TRIGGER: FAI YTD y/y better than -4.0% AND property better than -15.0%. BEARISH TRIGGER: FAI worse than -7.5% OR property worse than -20.5%. BACK-TEST: on the latest print (-6.7% / -19.2%) neither trigger fired - both sit inside the bands, so the status quo does NOT satisfy either side and the trigger is capable of failing on that period. THE TWO-PERIOD BACK-TEST IS INCOMPLETE: the prior period's exact figures were not obtained this run, and that is recorded as a gap rather than assumed. China activity is a DEMAND INPUT owned by commodity-macro-drivers, not proof of copper demand, and is referenced here rather than re-voted.

TIMING PROVEN for the cadence - NBS official manufacturing PMI on the last day of each month: 2026-08-31, 2026-09-30, 2026-10-31 (a SATURDAY - weekend handling NOT resolved this run), 2026-11-30, 2026-12-31; RatingDog/Caixin on the first business day following. WHY: macro.global-activity-demand-proxy is UNAVAILABLE in this run, so PMI is the only activity signal that will exist at all - and the profile is explicit that licensed PMI stays CONTEXTUAL. BULLISH TRIGGER: NBS manufacturing PMI above 50.0 in two consecutive months. BEARISH TRIGGER: below 49.0. The 50.0 line is definitionally fixed and basis-independent, which is the only reason a number is emitted here at all. THIS IS A DELIBERATELY WEAK TRIGGER AND IS LABELLED SO: the last two PMI prints were NOT obtained this run, so the section 17 two-period back-test CANNOT BE RUN and I cannot show what the threshold would have done. Strength held to 0.15 for that reason. Data need recorded.

TIMING VAGUE - PATTERN-DERIVED, and one source conflict is left UNRESOLVED on purpose. Window ~2026-10-14 to 2026-11-05, hence expiry 2026-11-05. Antofagasta Q3 production report expected late October because Q3-2025 landed 2025-10-23; Freeport-McMoRan Q3-2026 results in October with TWO SECONDARY SOURCES DISAGREEING BY A WEEK (2026-10-15 versus 2026-10-22). Neither company had published its Q3-2026 date as of 2026-08-28. WHY: mine supply is the profile's supply lens and two large swing assets are impaired - Grasberg still ramping from the September-2025 force majeure with pre-incident rates not before 2027, and Cobre Panama idle since November 2023. BULLISH TRIGGER: Antofagasta cuts FY2026 group copper guidance below the current 625 kt floor. BEARISH TRIGGER: Antofagasta raises the FY2026 range above the current 655 kt ceiling, or confirms the top of it. COMPARABLE (same basis - group attributable copper production, kt, full year): FY2026 guidance was 650-700 kt at the Q2-2026 production report (2026-07-14), cut to 625-655 kt at the 2026 half-year results. BACK-TEST on the last two prints: the CUT direction has fired once and the RAISE direction has not - demonstrably two-way and CAPABLE OF FAILING. GAP, stated rather than invented: H1-2026 actual group tonnage was NOT obtained, so I cannot compute what 625-655 kt implies for the unreported H2 run-rate; that arithmetic is owed. Production facts are causally owned by commodity-supply and are not re-voted here.

TIMING PROVEN - Federal Reserve tentative schedule: 2026-09-15/16 (with Summary of Economic Projections), 2026-10-27/28 (no SEP), 2026-12-08/09 (with SEP), decision 14:00 ET on day two; expiry set to the last meeting in the window. WHY: the run's dominant ADVERSE macro driver is the US 10-year real yield at 2.36% (2026-08-28), +54bp over twelve months to a multi-decade high; the last decision HELD at 3.50-3.75% and its only three dissents wanted a HIKE. BULLISH TRIGGER: a cut below 3.50-3.75%, or a Sep/Dec SEP median that lowers the 2027 dot, AND the 10-year real yield falling below 2.00% (-36bp from 2.36%) within ten business days. BEARISH TRIGGER: a hike above 3.75%, or the real yield rising above 2.60% (+24bp). COMPARABLE: the FOMC target range in force, 3.50-3.75%, on the same basis. BACK-TEST: at the last meeting the Committee held and the dissents were for a hike, and 2.36% sits between 2.00% and 2.60% - NEITHER trigger fired, so the status quo satisfies neither and the trigger is CAPABLE OF FAILING. BINDING ATTRIBUTION WARNING (MODULE_RULES section 4a): copper's +46.63% twelve-month move (US$4.51/lb to US$6.62/lb, +US$2.11/lb) is 0% EXPLAINED and 100% RESIDUAL by every macro driver the profile calls dominant, because no sourced copper/USD or copper/real-yield sensitivity exists and three candidate coefficients were refused on basis grounds. This row therefore tests whether the DRIVER moves; it carries NO coefficient onto the copper price, and no expected price move or supportive adjective may be inferred from it. Direction neutral for exactly that reason.

TIMING PROVEN FOR 2026-09-11 08:30 ET (August data); VAGUE for later 2026 prints, which follow the second-week pattern but were NOT confirmed this run. WHY: it is the input that moves the real yield tested in the FOMC row. BULLISH TRIGGER: core CPI slows enough to pull the 10-year real yield below 2.00%. BEARISH TRIGGER: core CPI accelerates and the real yield rises above 2.60%. THE THRESHOLDS ARE DELIBERATELY IDENTICAL TO THE FOMC ROW so the two calendar entries cannot vote twice on the same real-yield fact. BACK-TEST: the real yield stands at 2.36% (2026-08-28), between the two thresholds, so neither is currently satisfied - capable of failing. The same 0%-explained / 100%-residual attribution warning binds this row: no copper price sensitivity to the real yield exists in this run and none may be inferred. Strength held low because this is a second-order input to a driver that explains none of the observed move.

TIMING PROVEN FOR LME WEEK - week of 2026-10-19, Metals Seminar Monday 2026-10-19 at the QEII Centre, Westminster, LME Dinner the Tuesday; expiry set to the Friday of that week. BUT THE EVENT THAT ACTUALLY MATTERS HAS NO PUBLISHED DATE: the 2027 benchmark treatment/refining charge settlement is negotiated around this window and may land outside it. WHY: TC/RCs are the profile's concentrate-tightness tell. BULLISH TRIGGER: the 2027 benchmark TC/RC settles BELOW the 2026 benchmark (smelters paid less to treat concentrate = concentrate scarcer). BEARISH TRIGGER: settles ABOVE the 2026 benchmark. THE NUMERIC COMPARABLE IS MISSING AND IS NOT INVENTED: the required series copper.concentrate-tcrc is unavailable/unusable in this run and neither the 2026 nor the 2025 benchmark level was obtained, so the trigger is DIRECTIONAL ONLY, the section 17 two-period back-test CANNOT BE RUN, and the row is labelled WEAK for that reason. TC/RC evidence is causally owned by commodity-supply and is not a second vote for the same mine disruption. Data need recorded: the 2026 benchmark TC/RC level.

TIMING PROVEN - 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 (seven days), with make-up working days Sunday 2026-09-20 and Saturday 2026-10-10, per the State Council 2026 holiday notice as relayed by secondary sources. The COPPER profile is EXPLICIT that copper is NOT a weather commodity and that China seasonality is MILD, and the run's weather-seasonality orb returned not-a-driver/neutral - so this row must not be inflated into a seasonal thesis. NO NUMERIC TRIGGER IS EMITTED: the comparable would be SHFE warrant stock on the Friday before the holiday against the same point a year earlier, and that year-earlier point does not exist in this run. Role is context, not catalyst, and strength is 0.1 accordingly.

THE DOMINANT UNDATED BINARY. EXISTENCE PROVEN, TIMING VAGUE AND GENUINELY UNDATED - and NO DATE IS MANUFACTURED. The Commerce update to the President was due 2026-06-30 under Proclamation 10962 (signed 2025-07-30; Federal Register doc 2025-14893, published 2025-08-05). As of 2026-08-28 it is 59 DAYS LATE (2026-06-30 to 2026-08-28, my arithmetic) with NO replacement date published. Expiry is set to 2027-01-01 because a window END does exist even though a decision date does not: 2027-01-01 is the RECOMMENDED EFFECTIVE DATE (15% from 2027-01-01, 30% from 2028-01-01), so the question resolves one way or the other by then. That is a deadline, not a decision date, and it is 126 days out - OUTSIDE the 60-day tactical window (which ends 2026-10-27) and INSIDE the 365-day strategic window. IT IS NOT A DIRECTIONAL CATALYST, hence direction=neutral, and that is the finding rather than a hedge: duty imposed traps ~740 kt of US-located metal (69.8% of the 968.4 kt visible total) behind a 15-30% border charge - BULLISH for the ex-US price against 3.7 days of ex-US cover and 1.4 days of LME on-warrant cover; duty NOT imposed frees that same metal toward the seaborne market - BEARISH for the ex-US price and collapses the COMEX-over-LME premium. The two outcomes point opposite ways with comparable force and this run holds NO measured probability for either. BULLISH TRIGGER: a Federal Register proclamation imposing a refined-copper duty of at least 15% effective on or before 2027-01-01. BEARISH TRIGGER: a published determination not to impose, or 2027-01-01 arriving with no refined duty in force. COMPARABLE: the 0% Section 232 duty on refined cathode in force since 2025-08-01 (refined cathode, ore, concentrate, matte, anode and scrap were EXEMPTED from the 50% semis tariff). BACK-TEST on the last two reported events - the 2025-07-30 proclamation and the missed 2026-06-30 deadline - NEITHER trigger fired, so the status quo satisfies neither and both are CAPABLE OF FAILING. OPPOSING FACT, carried separately and NOT netted: a market-implied 14.6% chance the 15% takes effect on 2027-01-01, rising to 37% for a 30% duty by 2028-01-01 (broker research via FXStreet, 2026-08-10, verdict-stripped per MODULE_RULES section 2). GOVERNING RULE: under CLAUDE.md section 17 an undated catalyst does not support conviction and MUST NOT LIFT THE RATING IN EITHER DIRECTION; under MODULE_RULES section 11 it is NOT a proven critical risk and MUST NOT be used to force Avoid. It belongs in the risk register and the scenario span, not in the action verdict. The policy fact itself is causally owned by commodity-supply-security; this row owns only its CALENDAR STATUS and does not re-cast the tonnage vote.

TIMING VAGUE - WINDOW ONLY, politically set, no calendared date; expiry 2026-12-31 because President Mulino said the decision would be communicated publicly this year. The government is weighing a state mining company taking a 35-40% stake, or a lease model. WHY: the mine has been idle since November 2023, when Panama's Supreme Court ruled the concession law unconstitutional. BULLISH TRIGGER: the decision is deferred past 2026-12-31, or restart is refused - the mine stays out. BEARISH TRIGGER: a restart agreement with a named concentrate-shipment date, or shipments exceeding 3,200 t of contained copper in a subsequent reported quarter. COMPARABLE (same basis - contained copper tonnes actually processed/shipped): by end-June 2026 First Quantum had processed 2.1 Mt of stockpiled ore for about 3,200 t of contained copper, a token volume that evidences intent, not restored supply. BACK-TEST on the last two reported periods: no decision was made and shipments stood at ~3,200 t - the status quo satisfies NEITHER trigger, so both are CAPABLE OF FAILING. Direction neutral: this row owns the DATE WINDOW only; the lost-production tonnage is causally owned by commodity-supply and the legal/political restriction by commodity-supply-security, and neither is re-voted here. The mine's annual capacity was not sourced this run, so no share of world supply is asserted.

TIMING VAGUE. The joint ministerial order was signed 2026-06-29 with immediate effect (that date is proven) and carried a THREE-MONTH transition to a new by-product tax regime, which implies ~2026-09-29 - but NO published implementing date was obtained, so the window end is INFERRED and labelled so; expiry set to 2026-09-29 on that inference. SIZE, PRINTED SO IT CANNOT BE INFLATED: Q1-2026 DRC exports were 696,725 t of cathode versus 53,926 t of concentrate containing 18,863 t of copper metal, so concentrate is 2.6% of copper in reported export streams; annualised upper bound ~75 kt/yr contained Cu; 0.026 x 0.14 (DRC share of world mined copper, 2025) = ~0.36% of world mined copper, NOT the 14% a headline implies. BULLISH TRIGGER: extension to cathode, or waivers refused to the large operators. BEARISH TRIGGER: broad waivers or suspension of the order. BASE-RATE BACK-TEST (section 9): this is the FOURTH iteration of the same policy (2013, 2019, 2023, 2026) and the earlier three did not hold - the lapse side has effectively fired three times out of three previous rounds, so the trigger is set so that outcome is visible rather than assumed away, and it is CAPABLE OF FAILING. Strength held to 0.15 to stop a loud headline voting like a large one. The restriction tonnage is causally owned by commodity-supply-security and is not re-counted here.
